name: Tomato

schedule.notes: Bottom-heat to 75 to 80 F speeds germination.
Wait until overnight lows are reliably above 50 F.
After first fruit set, balanced fertilizer.

harvest.cues: Fruit fully colored, slight give when gently squeezed. Twist or snip to avoid tearing the vine.
harvest.storageNotes: Counter-ripen stem-side down. Do not refrigerate ripe tomatoes — destroys flavor and texture.

varieties.name: Cherokee Purple
varieties.notes: Dusky pink-purple beefsteak, complex sweet-savory flavor. Prone to cracking in heavy rain; mulch heavily.

varieties.name: Sungold
varieties.notes: Very prolific orange cherry, almost tropical sweetness. Skin splits near ripeness in rainy weeks — pick early.

notes: Determinate types want a stake; indeterminate types want a tall cage or a string-trellis system. Pinch suckers on indeterminates for cleaner airflow.
